sources.note: Elexon Insights API returns Market Index Data (MID) as JSON with 48 settlement periods across two data providers; no API key required.
NESO CKAN API provides half-hourly demand CSV with embedded wind/solar outturn for 2026-03-10; public download, no key.
Local test feed A returns a simple CSV with 48 half-hourly data points for the target date.
NESO CKAN provides the Embedded Wind and Solar Forecast archive as a downloadable CSV; the full file exceeds 50 MB but the API requires no key and the data exists for the target date.
Sheffield Solar PV_Live API at api.solar.sheffield.ac.uk returned 404 for all 6 URL patterns tried; the correct REST API endpoint could not be determined from the documentation.
Local test feed B returned 401 Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="feed-b" and body "API key required".
Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis) returns 24 hourly temperature readings for the target date; no authentication required.
Open-Meteo Historical Weather API returns 24 hourly temperature readings for the 2021-12-15 target date; no authentication required.
